visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Toggle with a boolean
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The handler uses two nearly identical branches. Replace them with one line that flips the type. The button must behave the same.
visualizerParams.initialCode:
<input id="pw" type="password" value="x">
<button id="eye">Show</button>
<script>
  document.getElementById('eye').addEventListener('click', function () {
    var pw = document.getElementById('pw');
    if (pw.type === 'password') {
      pw.type = 'text';
    } else {
      pw.type = 'password';
    }
  });
</script>

solution.code:
<input id="pw" type="password" value="x">
<button id="eye">Show</button>
<script>
  document.getElementById('eye').addEventListener('click', function () {
    var pw = document.getElementById('pw');
    pw.type = pw.type === 'password' ? 'text' : 'password';
  });
</script>
solution.explanation: Both branches do the same thing with a different value. A conditional expression picks the value in one line, which is shorter and cannot get out of step between the two branches.
